planningInconsistencies.description: Per-segment quota minima/maxima sum to 37/57 completed interviews, while the MC-09 plan, the experiment registry and this milestone's sample target state 40-80 total. The totals are not derived from the quotas.
planningInconsistencies.resolution: Dated plan amendment reconciling the quota table with the total target before any fielding. MC-10 does not change either value.

planningInconsistencies.description: Three conflicting per-segment minimum/target readings exist: plan summary 'minimum 5, target 8 (operators/retailers minimum 3)', segment table SEG-04/05 minimum 5, experiment registry 'target 8-10' (which exceeds the max-8 quota).
planningInconsistencies.resolution: Single authoritative quota statement in a dated amendment; segments must not be silently redefined.

planningInconsistencies.description: EXP-MC10-04/05 require n>=8 per segment per construct, but preserved quotas cap SEG-04 at 7, SEG-05 at 7, SEG-06 at 5 and SEG-08 at 6. A compliant pricing result is unreachable for those segments without an amendment.
planningInconsistencies.resolution: Either amend the quotas or report those segments as BELOW_REGISTERED_MINIMUM. No silent reduction of the minimum.
